name: The Black Cloth Painting
source:
A top art dealer’s painting is stolen, and Captain Sharley is on the case. But the truth may be more complicated than it appears.

[From [url=https://veitralf.itch.io/black-cloth-painting]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一位顶尖艺术品经销商名下的画作失窃，沙利警长受命接手此案。然而，案件背后的真相或许远比表面看起来更加扑朔迷离。

[摘自[url=https://veitralf.itch.io/black-cloth-painting]itch.io[/url]]
